title: Can Speech Therapy sessions be conducted with AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) tools?
metaTitle: Use of AAC Tools in Speech Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how Pinnacle Blooms Network uses Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) tools in Speech Therapy sessions to support children's communication skills.
html: Absolutely. In fact, at Pinnacle Blooms, we believe each child is unique and may require different communication aids. We employ AAC tools like symbols, pictures, or electronic devices when needed to develop the child's ability to express themselves. Our experts guide children and families to help make the best use of these tools for effective communication.
